title: Self-service model intake: signed-weight manifest, conversion sandbox, and deterministic smoke suite
creator: Liam Chen
description: Build a self-service, end-to-end intake pipeline for community/OSS model weights that enforces signed manifests, performs reproducible conversion in an isolated sandbox, and runs a deterministic smoke test + lightweight perf profiling to decide an initial pin recommendation. This ticket covers the gateway contract and the first-phase runner (conversion + smoke) for MLP/Transformer artifacts. The goal is to reduce manual triage, shorten time-to-publish, and eliminate common conversion failure modes that block downstream runtime onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Signed-weight manifest upload accepted only after manifest signature verification via configured KMS/HSM keys
Uploaded weight bundle is staged in an immutable sandbox environment where conversion to runtime format (safetensors/quantized blob) completes deterministically
A deterministic smoke suite runs within the sandbox (sequence-level correctness, kv-cache sanity, memory/cpu footprint), and outputs a structured profile suitable for the profile publisher
Pipeline produces a recommended pin candidate with metadata: model_id, format, quantization profile, sample-perf (p50/p95), and a confidence tag
All artifacts and logs are stored in S3 with retention tags and appear in Console intake UI with links to conversion logs and smoke artifacts
Telemetry emits conversion success/failure, deterministic-check failures, and signature verification metrics to the onboarding dashboard
Automated rollbacks: manifest rejection reasons are surfaced to uploaders with actionable remediation hints
implementation_notes: Manifest schema: issuer, model_name, weights_uri, hash (sha256), format_hint, declared_arch, provenance_notes, signing_key_id, version
Signature verification: integrate KMS HSM signing verification flow; fallback to local verification during dev mode with strict flag
Sandbox: Kubernetes Job pulling PR-referenced container image 'onboard-runner:v0.3' with CPU/GPU quotas; ephemeral PVC mounted for conversion artifacts
Conversion toolchain: use a hermetic toolset (torch-convert v2.1 shim + safetensors packer + fused-kernel hints) with deterministic seed for ops that threaten nondeterminism
Deterministic smoke suite: run a canonical set of prompts (10 short, 5 long) with fixed RNG seeds; verify token-level checksums and KV cache replay identical across two runs
Perf shim: small profiler collects token throughput, peak GPU memory, and per-call kernel time for 1- and 8-token generation workloads
Pin recommendation heuristic: prefer non-quantized > q8_0 > q4_0 only when perf delta within 10% and checksum agreements pass; otherwise recommend 'needs-quant' or 'human-review'
Observability: structured JSON output for conversion logs (line-delimited), smoke results, and a single profile artifact JSON consumed by the profile-publisher service
Errors: map common conversion exceptions to remediation messages and add into frontend UX link back to docs/FAQ
test_plan: Unit: manifest parser and signature verifier with real test vectors (valid/expired/revoked keys)
Integration: staged upload -> sandbox conversion -> smoke run using a small LLaMA2-like toy model; assert profile produced and uploaded
Fuzz: corrupted weight file, mismatched hash, missing tensors -> ensure graceful rejection and informative error
Load: simulate 20 concurrent lightweight conversions to validate autoscaling behavior of sandbox pool
Security: KMS permission boundary tests, verify signing keys cannot be exfiltrated from sandbox
E2E: UI upload flow -> notification email with remediation hints on failure -> successful pin publish path
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal-only): enable for internal orgs and partner contributors; collect false positives/negatives
Phase 2 (beta): opt-in by community submitters; guard with rate limits and quarantine bucket
Phase 3 (GA): enable self-service for all uploads with hardened telemetry and expanded retention; update Console onboarding page
Rollback: revert intake-beta flag and move queued uploads to manual review queue if critical regressions observed
telemetry_and_observability: Traces: attach request_id to pod logs, correlate to console intake event for quick triage
Logs: line-delimited JSON to S3 with structured fields (step, err_code, stack_id, duration_ms)
Dashboards: onboard-conversion latency heatmap, failure taxonomy pie, per-image error rates
Alerts: conversion_failure_rate > 5% over 15m triggers first-oncall paging; signature-verification anomaly triggers security pager
progress_updates: 2025-02-19: Kickoff meeting with PM/Design/Infra. Agreed schema baseline and KMS integration surface. Assigned sandbox infra to infra-team
2025-02-25: Initial manifest validator library (Python) landed in onboarding repo; added unit tests for 6 schema permutations
2025-02-28: Sandbox prototype job runs conversion container and completes basic safetensors conversion for tiny-llama test weights (success)
2025-03-03: Deterministic smoke harness implemented; first dual-run checksum mismatch discovered and root-caused to nondeterministic dropout op in conversion toolchain
2025-03-05: Patch submitted to conversion runtime to fix nondeterministic op; awaiting review on GH PR #512. KMS team requires least-privileged key role before enabling signature verification in prod
review_feedback: PM (Aisha Malik): please add explicit fields in profile JSON for 'checksum_algorithm' and 'seed_used' so audits can replay tests
Design (Tomás Rivera): UX should show failure category (signature|conversion|smoke) with a one-click 'reupload' that pre-fills remediation hints
Security (R. Gupta): require attestation header for images used in sandbox; add audit log entry when keys are accessed
Runtime (Maya Svensson): recommend adding a fast-path that skips quantization attempts for models with <6B params in phase 1
